create_dictionary_read_vocab: create a Dictionary instance from a vocabulary file path using Dictionary.read_vocab
build_indexed_data: build indexed sentence data with positions and word IDs using Dictionary.index_data
test_dictionary_index: test the Dictionary.index method to look up word IDs with optional unknown fallback
refactor_dictionary_prune: refactor the Dictionary.prune method to limit vocabulary size to a maximum word count
review_dictionary_equality: review the Dictionary.__eq__ method to compare two dictionaries for structural equality
